cohort: Pregnant patients with and without colorectal cancer (CRC) from the Nationwide Inpatient Sample (NIS) database from 2009 to 2019.
finding: Pregnant patients with colorectal cancer are at increased risk for adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes, including higher rates of maternal death, cesarean section, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Pregnant patients with CRC had higher odds of cesarean section (AOR 1.78, 95% CI 1.05-3.03), preterm birth (AOR 4.16, 95% CI 2.05-8.47).
